_note: Assumed inputs, schemas and frozen parameters for 7.1. Paths are {key: path_for key, rel: relative}. Build agent, 2026-11-05. Edit freely.

corpus_windows.schema: window_id, stack_path (7-band 0.5 m stack, EPSG:6346 or a projected CRS in metres), ground_ppsm, laz_glob (optional), bbox (optional X0,Y0,X1,Y1)

corpus_exclusions.what: every audit block plus buffer (from P2, assumed)

validated_labels.schema: polygons, layer pit_inside, columns status in {valid, invalid, undecided}

mask._targets_note: the stack has no raw DEM. lrm_25 is the DEM minus its 25 m smooth, the detrended elevation. lrm_5 is local relief

contrast._views_note: the stack has no hillshade or curvature. view1 is the slope and texture group, view2 the relief and openness group

finetune._primary_note: user decision, named in the preregistration before any fine-tune runs
finetune._audit_model_fold_note: user decision. Which fold model scores the sealed audit blocks in --audit-once. Null refuses (review 7.1-02)

scoring._note: cutoff, min area, IoU and matching come from ek.policy_for(task) via sc.load_policy (F02, 2026-11-06). The old thr 0.10 is gone. k_per_km2 is kept for pooled recall and equals the policy value

_G_note: User decision, set before scoring (here or in the preregistration JSON, key G). Null gives an inconclusive decision. G is never derived from the runs it judges and never floored. G_raw (A0 f=0.50 minus f=0.25) is reported as a diagnostic only (review 7.2-01, 2026-11-06)
